1.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER2SUB1_00575_RECORDSYSTEM_000_050
1.description: <blip> Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Thank you for agreeing to knock Thiuna into shape.
1.translation_description: <blip> Salve, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Grazie per aver accettato di mettere Thiuna in riga.

2.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER2SUB1_00575_RECORDSYSTEM_000_100
2.description: <blip> Be kindly informed that your every action is currently being recorded. <buzz> Remember to smile.
2.translation_description: <blip> Ti informo che ogni tua azione è al momento registrata. <buzz> Ricordati di sorridere.

3.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER2SUB1_00575_RECORDSYSTEM_000_150
3.description: <blip> Glory be to Allag. Long may she endure.
3.translation_description: <blip> Gloria all'Impero Allagano. Possa durare in eterno.

4.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER2SUB1_00575_RECORDSYSTEM_000_160
4.description: <blip> Water and nodes do not mix. As a precautionary measure, I must maintain a safe distance from amaro.
4.translation_description: <blip> L'acqua e i nodi eterici non vanno d'accordo. Per precauzione, devo mantenere una distanza di sicurezza dagli amaro.

5.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER2SUB1_00575_RECORDSYSTEM_000_200
5.description: <blip> Be advised that forced shutdowns may result in corrupted data. It is recommended that you perform regular backups.
5.translation_description: <blip> Attenzione: gli spegnimenti forzati possono corrompere i dati. Si consiglia di eseguire regolarmente copie di backup.

6.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER2SUB1_00575_RECORDSYSTEM_000_250
6.translation_description: <beep> Unità di elaborazione rallentata... Prestazioni... ridotte... <buzzzzzz>

8.name: TEXT_CTSDKBCHARACTER2SUB1_00575_RECORDSYSTEM_000_350
8.description: <blip> All data pertaining to <hex:022903EB0203> has been encrypted under the Protect protocol. <buzz> Your personal information is safe with me.
8.translation_description: <blip> Tutti i dati relativi a <hex:022903EB0203> sono stati cifrati con il protocollo Protect. <buzz> Le tue informazioni personali sono al sicuro con me.
